'''Wobbler''' is a [[Lightning]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Boltskipper]] at 6 stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Ready, aim, and bolt! That's all Wobbler needs to take down the next [[Zobos|Zobo]] with precision!"

Wobbler is an early game, blue rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
Wobbler resembles a combination of a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mudskipper mudskipper] and a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Catfish catfish]. It has a light navy blue body, white underbelly, and vibrant orange lips. It has two bright blue whiskers that stick out from its lips/cheeks that resemble lightning bolts. It has small darker blue fins on its sides and a small tail fin. It has large white squarish eyes with black pupils.

== Trivia ==

* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Wanna wooble and hop? Its time to do the zobo bop! Are you ready?"
* Prior to the update on 5/13/26, its bio description said: "Emits weak electric currents from the side fins. Not that great at reading the room."

==Strategy==
[[File:Wobbler Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Wobbler's attack range]]
Good early lightning DPS. Use until better lightning DPS acquired or until evolved.
